info.title: Bidora Tenderpreneur Dashboard
info.description: TP-F02 bounded organization dashboard composed through independently authorized Commercial and Opportunity owner ports. It is an operational recent-items view, not analytics, a global total, or action authority.

get.description: Requires a current active Tenderpreneur membership/context and all source permissions needed for the complete response: tenderpreneur.organization.subscription.read, tenderpreneur.opportunity.read and tenderpreneur.bid.read. Any denied, unavailable or inconsistent source suppresses the complete response. Tenant/context headers are selectors only and routing remains server-owned.

200.description: Complete bounded dashboard with independent has_more indicators.

Failure.description: Stable safe failure without partial dashboard data, database locators, provider diagnostics or unauthorized record counts.

x-invariants: every owner source rechecks current membership, context generation and exact capabilities
all tenant workflow reads use the server-owned routing assignment and one tenant database at a time
a source denial or failure returns no partial dashboard
has_more means only that the bounded recent window is incomplete and is never represented as a global total
dashboard data never grants mutation authority
